title: SOUKS OF MARRAKECH MOROCCO || WHAT CAN YOU BUY ? (VIRTUAL TRAVEL TOUR)
speaker: TravelandTellno1
zh: 【TravelandTellno1】摩洛哥馬拉喀什露天市集 ||你能買什麼？ （虛擬旅遊）（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: Today we will discover souks of Marrakesh, we will negotiate things, we will show you
cues.en: Today we will discover souks of Marrakesh, we will negotiate things, we will show you
cues.zh: 今天我們將探索馬拉喀什的露天市場，我們將談判事情，我們將向您展示

cues.text: what you buy here in the markets of Marrakesh.
cues.en: what you buy here in the markets of Marrakesh.
cues.zh: 你在馬拉喀什市場買的東西。

cues.text: So while you are visiting the souks of Marrakesh, you need to have cash, deer hunts, if not
cues.en: So while you are visiting the souks of Marrakesh, you need to have cash, deer hunts, if not
cues.zh: 所以當你參觀馬拉喀什的露天市場時，你需要有現金，如果沒有的話，可以去獵鹿

cues.text: they will not accept euros or dollars, one euro it's about 10 deer hunts.
cues.en: they will not accept euros or dollars, one euro it's about 10 deer hunts.
cues.zh: 他們不接受歐元或美元，一歐元大約相當於10隻鹿的狩獵量。

cues.text: This is a little bit, this is sweet, but change color, change color.
cues.en: This is a little bit, this is sweet, but change color, change color.
cues.zh: 這個有點，這個甜，但是變色，變色。

cues.text: We have blue, we have black, blue, nice color.
cues.en: We have blue, we have black, blue, nice color.
cues.zh: 我們有藍色，我們有黑色，藍色，漂亮的顏色。

cues.text: Overall we feel pretty safe in Marrakesh, also by walking in Medina, people always want to
cues.en: Overall we feel pretty safe in Marrakesh, also by walking in Medina, people always want to
cues.zh: 總的來說，我們在馬拉喀什感覺很安全，而且在麥地那散步，人們總是想

cues.text: sell you something or trying to speak with you.
cues.en: sell you something or trying to speak with you.
cues.zh: 向您推銷東西或試圖與您交談。

cues.text: If you like corn packet from one piece, you can leave it to you for maybe 6 pieces.
cues.en: If you like corn packet from one piece, you can leave it to you for maybe 6 pieces.
cues.zh: 如果你喜歡一份玉米包，你可以留給你大概六份。

cues.text: But not from there, so then we leave it for you.
cues.en: But not from there, so then we leave it for you.
cues.zh: 但不是從那裡開始，所以我們把它留給你。

cues.text: Yeah, but it's what's the last price?
cues.en: Yeah, but it's what's the last price?
cues.zh: 是啊，不過最後的價格是多少？

cues.text: After eating traditional food and visiting everything that is to visit in the city, what's
cues.en: After eating traditional food and visiting everything that is to visit in the city, what's
cues.zh: 吃完傳統美食並參觀了這座城市的所有景點後，還有什麼

cues.text: My lovely girlfriend needs a new purse.
cues.en: My lovely girlfriend needs a new purse.
cues.zh: 我可愛的女朋友需要一個新錢包。

cues.text: She plans to use her negotiation techniques to get the best price.
cues.en: She plans to use her negotiation techniques to get the best price.
cues.zh: 她計劃運用自己的談判技巧來獲得最優惠的價格。
讓我們看看會發生什麼。

cues.text: So my girlfriend just bought a nice purse, she negotiated it.
cues.en: So my girlfriend just bought a nice purse, she negotiated it.
cues.zh: 所以我女朋友剛買了一個不錯的錢包，她協商了一下。

cues.text: So basically he said that I would buy it for 75 dirhams, which is 7.5 euros.
cues.en: So basically he said that I would buy it for 75 dirhams, which is 7.5 euros.
cues.zh: 所以基本上他說我會花75迪拉姆買，也就是7.5歐元。

cues.text: And we negotiated and the final price was 50, which means 5 euros.
cues.en: And we negotiated and the final price was 50, which means 5 euros.
cues.zh: 然後我們協商了一下，最後的價格是50，也就是5歐元。

cues.text: Oh my god, you're so great.
cues.en: Oh my god, you're so great.

cues.zh: 你是有史以來最好的女朋友。

cues.text: That was my offer and he took it.
cues.en: That was my offer and he took it.
cues.zh: 這是我的提議，他接受了。

cues.text: Now on, you will negotiate everything.
cues.en: Now on, you will negotiate everything.
cues.zh: 從現在開始，一切都由你來協商。

cues.text: So I have a nice bag.
cues.en: So I have a nice bag.
cues.zh: 所以我有一個漂亮的包。

cues.text: And they said that it's manual created with raffia straight from Marrakesh.
cues.en: And they said that it's manual created with raffia straight from Marrakesh.
cues.zh: 他們說它是用直接來自馬拉喀什的拉菲草手工製作的。

cues.text: We're in Jema El Vla and we caught the most scientific sunset.
cues.en: We're in Jema El Vla and we caught the most scientific sunset.
cues.zh: 我們在 Jema El Vla 看到了最科學的日落。

cues.text: Don't forget to subscribe, travel and tell no one.
cues.en: Don't forget to subscribe, travel and tell no one.
cues.zh: 不要忘記訂閱、旅行並且不要告訴任何人。
